sections.title: Needs a person
sections.note: Law first, then the binder, then the book.
sections.sql: select level, what, record, issue, source from attention order by case level when 'breached' then 0 when 'overdue' then 1 when 'due soon' then 2 when 'stale' then 3 else 4 end, what

sections.title: Premium cap used
sections.sql: select reference, insurer, currency, ends_on, days_left, gwp_cap_cents, gwp_cents, percent_used, projected_gwp_cents from binder_usage order by percent_used desc nulls last

sections.title: Bordereaux not sent
sections.sql: select binder, to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') as month, due_on, lines, currency, gross_cents from bordereaux_due where submitted_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: Premium owed to insurers
sections.sql: select binder, insurer, to_char(month, 'YYYY-MM') as month, due_on, currency, unremitted_cents from remittance_due where unremitted_cents <> 0 order by due_on

sections.title: Expiring with nothing bound
sections.note: Australian renewable policies need the expiry notice 14 days out.
sections.sql: select number, insured, broker, product, expiry, days_left, currency, annual_premium_cents, renewal_quote, s58_applies, expiry_notice_on, claims from renewals_due order by expiry

sections.title: Open claims
sections.sql: select number, policy, insured, country, notified_on, days_open, currency, reserve_cents, paid_cents, decision, handler from open_claims order by days_open desc

sections.title: Loss ratio by binder
sections.sql: select binder, insurer, currency, written_cents, incurred_cents, claims, loss_ratio_percent from loss_ratio
